Nikhil Chaudhary to Tom Banton, SIX, had to be a sixer to finish it off! The batters hug each other. The English camp gets up as well and shake hands amongst each other. That was dropped short, Tom Banton camped back and pulled it over deep mid. Bye bye ball and the second game. This has been a run rampage. England have tracked down 185 in 13.1 overs

21:10 Local Time, 11:10 GMT, 16:40 IST: Australia have been blown away.They were hit by a blizzard which sustained for a decent time and did considerable damage. Australia had 184 runs to play with but it turned out to be very less thanks to the opening pair of Donald and Salt. Donald started the onslaught, got to his fifty off 18 balls which by the way is the third joint fastest in this format for England. Salt had enough of watching the high balls and took on Davies and slammed 4 sixes and a four in an over. Salt also got to his fifty and the pair added 151 for the first wicket before being separated. That had killed off the chase. Brook and Tom Banton came in and continued being part of the fun. 16 sixes were hit in this chase and England never put their foot down off the accelerator. The series is now 1-1. Hang on for the presentation!

Harry Brook | England Captain: [On the extraordinary batting performance and the explosive opening partnership] Speechless actually. That was unbelievable, that opening partnership was explosive to say the least. [On England's assessment of Australia's total at the halfway stage and the pitch conditions] Yeah, the pitch played a lot better than we thought it was going to. We anticipated a little bit of dew for it to skid on a little bit and it did in the second half. And the two of them just put on an absolute clinic. So they should be very proud of their performance. [On the contribution of the spinners, particularly Adil Rashid, and his importance to the team] He's been around the block for many years now. Exceptional performer and he's such a wily old character as well, him and Dawson to have them work through the middle tonight made my life a lot easier.

It is 1-1. The series has the balance it deserves. England were too good today. They just didn't relent with the bat. It might have looked on an even keel at the half-way stage but the run chase just went one way. Australia tried their cards but nothing worked. Hope you liked the coverage for this one.
